description: This Java source file defines the class JsonPointerInvalidException, a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate invalid JSON Pointer formats. It provides builder methods for creating instances with standardized messages about common JSON pointer errors, such as consecutive or outer slashes.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an invalid JSON Pointer, extending JsonRuntimeException.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a fluent API to construct instances of JsonPointerInvalidException with specific messages related to JSON Pointer validation errors.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method to initiate a builder for creating a new JsonPointerInvalidException instance.

methods.name: newBuilderForConsecutiveSlashes
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-configured with a message indicating that consecutive slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.

methods.name: newBuilderForOuterSlashes
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-configured with a message indicating that leading or trailing slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.

methods.name: jsonPointer
methods.description: Builder method to set the invalid JSON pointer string, generating an error message indicating invalidity.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a JsonPointerInvalidException with the accumulated builder parameters.
